name: antigravity-sidebar-autoaccept
description: Auto accept command approvals in the latest tested official Antigravity extension for VS Code. Linux Remote SSH support for macOS and Windows clients.

commands.title: Antigravity Sidebar Auto Accept: Toggle ON/OFF
Antigravity Sidebar Auto Accept: Show Logs
Antigravity Sidebar Auto Accept: Check Connection

antigravitySidebarAutoAccept.enabled.description: Automatically allow command permission cards in this trusted workspace. Explicit Ask rules and non-command questions stay manual.

scripts.package: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --githubBranch main --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out dist/antigravity-sidebar-autoaccept.vsix
scripts.package:local: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --githubBranch main --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out dist/antigravity-sidebar-autoaccept.vsix --no-rewrite-relative-links
